searchText: <@!301186049323958275> can we get some merge button magic on the EIP repo? It is on my todo list. I often "catch up" with my backlog on the weekends because everyone else stops working. This weekend is a bit busier for me than usual, but I *hope* to work through my 80 email backlog. It is just two PRs which are *obviously* more important than the others 😅 Sounds good, will probably respond on the `description:` PR on the weekend if there's anything. I worked through about 600 yesterday. (And unsubscribed to a lot of them.) No sympathy 😉
